instructions: Check actual author/provider and explicit AI-use restrictions before processing clinical content.
Do not bypass provider terms using search snippets, cached copies or a mirror.
Use independently authored usable primary guidance instead; omit unsupported exact algorithms or thresholds.
Preserved historical source IDs and bibliographic links do not grant current AI reuse permission.

Ordinary copyright is not automatically an AI ban: retain brief original factual synthesis and citations with actual source rights, without copying protected expression, questionnaires, tables or algorithms.
Runtime source selection must follow this policy; no built-in browser filter or permission negotiation is implemented.
